_about: USD per million tokens, used by qa-event / qa-stage-gate to price a stage from its transcript. Anthropic first-party API list prices as cached in the claude-api reference on 2026-10-06; cacheWrite is not listed there and is taken as 1.25 x input (the 5-minute cache rate); the Haiku cache read is not listed either and is taken as 0.1 x input. On a subscription plan the number is the API-equivalent cost, not the bill. Edit for your contract; a model missing here is reported with tokens and no cost.
